'''Bradwood Landing LNG Sendout Pipeline''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/enforcement-legal/legal/court-cases/state-oregon-et-al-v-ferc-2|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Bradwood, Oregon to Kelso, Washington.

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Bradwood Landing LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/enforcement-legal/legal/court-cases/state-oregon-et-al-v-ferc-2|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''36.3 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/enforcement-legal/legal/court-cases/state-oregon-et-al-v-ferc-2|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/lng/article/17268179/ferc-approves-oregon-columbia-river-lng-project|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ferc.gov/enforcement-legal/legal/court-cases/state-oregon-et-al-v-ferc-2|title=ferc.gov|website=ferc.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2006<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/lng/article/17268179/ferc-approves-oregon-columbia-river-lng-project|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
